items.title: Darron Lee's murder trial is set for September 20, 2027
items.text: Former NFL linebacker Darron Lee, a first-round pick of the Jets in 2016, faces charges in Tennessee of killing his girlfriend.

items.title: Colts put Arden Key on IR, elevate Nick Westbrook-Ikhine
items.text: Word this week was that Colts defensive end Arden Key will miss multiple weeks with a hamstring injury and the team confirmed it on Saturday.

items.title: Browns elevate DTs Sam Kamara, Chris Williams from practice squad
items.text: The Browns have elevated defensive tackle Sam Kamara and defensive tackle Chris Williams from the practice squad for Sunday's game against the Jets, the team announced.

items.title: Report: Ravens conducted Cam Jurgens's physical at Eagles facility before finalizing trade
items.text: The Ravens completed a trade with the Eagles for center Cam Jurgens this week and they handled the final steps before the deal was done differently than their last high-profile attempt at a swap.

items.title: Texans are the likely destination for Marvin Harrison Jr.
items.text: Negotiations have focused on second-round pick in 2028 vs. second-round pick in 2027.

items.title: Report: Cardinals will be trading receiver Marvin Harrison Jr.
items.text: The team hasn't been named; the thinking is it's the Texans.

items.title: As Bears intend to build a dome, Mike Ditka would not approve
items.text: The passing of larger-than-life NFL legend Mike Ditka has sparked a flood of great stories and clips from Ditka's time in football.

items.title: Brock Purdy catches Josh Allen at 3-1 to win NFL MVP
items.text: Purdy's first four games have yielded a passer rating of 126.3.

items.title: Khalil Mack could return to the Bears
items.text: Eight years after the Bears traded for pass rusher Khalil Mack, the Bears could be doing it all over again.

items.title: Ravens are much different with and without Lamar Jackson
items.text: As expected, given that he's week-to-week with an ankle injury, Ravens quarterback Lamar Jackson will miss Sunday night's game against the Falcons.

items.title: Aaron Donald: No setbacks, I plan on playing Monday
items.text: Rams head coach Sean McVay said early in the week that defensive tackle Aaron Donald was trending toward a return to the lineup against the Bills on Monday night and things remain on track in Los Angeles.

items.title: Alvin Kamara will soon become the sixth NFL player with 5,000 yards rushing and receiving
items.text: Kamara has 7,324 rushing yards and 4,995 receiving yards in his NFL career.

items.title: Aaron Rodgers set to move ahead of Peyton Manning on the all-time touchdown pass list
items.text: With his next touchdown pass, Aaron Rodgers will have more than Peyton Manning, counting the playoffs.

items.title: Multiple playoff teams have never started 0-5
items.text: One of the five 0-4 teams entering Week 5 (the Buccaneers) has finally gotten its first win of 2026.

items.title: Joey Porter Jr.'s illness invites speculation that it was contract related (even if it wasn't)
items.text: Last night's Buccaneers-Cowboys game was preceded by the unexpected news that cornerback Joey Porter Jr. would miss the contest due to a sudden illness.

items.title: Chiefs, Vikings are first pair of non-playoff teams since 2013 to start 4-0
items.text: The NFL has only three 4-0 teams after four weeks.

items.title: Injuries to LT Tyler Guyton, WR CeeDee Lamb are not serious
items.text: The X-rays on Cowboys left tackle Tyler Guyton's back were negative, coach Brian Schottenheimer said Friday.

items.title: Broncos OC Davis Webb: "Not ideal" to lose playcalling role, excited to see how we respond
items.text: Broncos offensive coordinator Davis Webb's job description underwent a dramatic change this week.

items.title: Seahawks DT Leonard Williams has no injury designation
items.text: Seahawks defensive tackle Leonard Williams (ankle) has no injury designation.

items.title: Broncos rule out Pat Surtain II, Riley Moss
items.text: The Broncos ruled out both of their starting cornerbacks for Sunday's game against the Chargers.

items.title: 49ers wide receiver Mike Evans has no injury designation
items.text: 49ers wide receiver Mike Evans does not have an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Seahawks.

items.title: Joe Alt, Derwin James among Chargers ruled out for Sunday
items.text: The Chargers won't have either of their starting offensive tackles for Sunday's game against the Broncos.

items.title: Dolphins claim RB Kaytron Allen off waivers
items.text: The Dolphins have added a running back.

items.title: Titans WR Carnell Tate is questionable with back injury
items.text: The Titans list wide receiver Carnell Tate as questionable for Sunday's game against the Texans.

items.title: Eagles sign RB Carson Steele, C Jake Majors to active roster
items.text: The Eagles' long injury report led them to make a handful of roster moves on Friday afternoon.

items.title: Saquon Barkley out, Jalen Hurts (calf) added to report but will play
items.text: The Eagles will be shorthanded once again in Week 5, and their quarterback now has an injury issue — though it won’t keep him from playing.

items.title: Malik Nabers has no injury designation for Sunday
items.text: Giants wide receiver Malik Nabers would like the team to take more shots in his direction in the passing game and he'll be available for them to follow up on that against the Commanders.

items.title: Texans will have Azeez Al-Shaair, Will Anderson Jr., Jadeveon Clowney
items.text: The Texans ruled out wide receiver Tank Dell, who is working his way back from a gruesome 2024 knee injury that wiped out his 2025 season.

items.title: Zay Flowers, Marlon Humphrey questionable for Ravens this weekend
items.text: Ravens head coach Jesse Minter shared the headline of the team's Week 5 injury report when he announced that quarterback Lamar Jackson has been ruled out for Sunday night's game against the Ravens.

items.title: 49ers release DL Ogbo Okoronkwo
items.text: The 49ers released defensive lineman Ogbo Okoronkwo on Friday, the team announced.
